title.purpose: A floating card's title; the only overlay size that outranks its content.

instrument.purpose: JetBrains Mono for every number, caps micro-label (tracking 1.2px), keycap, cwd/git/telemetry line, and the sidebar rail. Data speaks mono; prose speaks system.

shadows.name: glass-panel
shadows.purpose: The single floating-card shadow (dark seeds). Light seeds: rgba(0,0,0,0.12). Every overlay shares it — one altitude.

shadows.name: active-card-light-only
shadows.purpose: The active tab card on LIGHT seeds only. Dark seeds cast no at-rest shadows anywhere.

motion.name: needle
motion.purpose: The mechanical settle — reserved for the connect handshake, the one orchestrated moment. Fast attack, long decel, no overshoot. No springs anywhere in the system.

motion.name: stack-reflow
motion.purpose: A whole column reflowing (toast spine expand/collapse).

narrative.overview: A machine hall at night: warm graphite housings, and light on the floor means exactly one thing — work in progress. Each project wears its own enamel tag colour as a 2px spine; the material glows where an agent works, holds an amber lamp where it needs a hand, and cools to drained gray when the work stops. FOUNDRY keeps every purge law of its predecessor (no at-rest ornament, depth by light, closed ladders, mono instrument voice) and widens the vocabulary where the product grew: five surface rungs instead of three, and chroma readmitted as information only, in three budgeted registers. Every colour is generated from an OKLCH seed and audited with APCA; Foundry Ember (warm graphite, teal accent) is the default seed.
keyCharacteristics: Heat is life: working = colour, waiting = amber, past = drained gray; chrome at rest is warm graphite structure
Three chroma registers with hard budgets: IDENTITY (8 project hues, spine + wash), STATE (closed agent-state machine), HAZARD (one amber, one meaning)
Five surface rungs (void → ground → face → raised → lift); flat square panes cut by 1px void seams
Moderate contrast by design: primary ink APCA Lc ~ 85; no pure black surfaces, no pure white text
One engine, many seeds: a theme is an OKLCH seed swap, never a per-theme redesign

rules.name: The Heat-Is-Life Rule
rules.body: Colour is state, temperature is structure. A surface at rest is warm graphite; it takes chroma only while something is alive on it and drains to gray the moment the signal stops.

rules.name: The Three-Registers Rule
rules.body: Chroma is spent from exactly three budgets. IDENTITY: 2px spine + at most 5% wash, never per-row plates or recoloured text. STATE: the closed agent-state machine (working/awaiting/done/idle). HAZARD: one amber, one meaning — an agent needs you.

rules.name: The Seeded-Engine Rule
rules.body: No hand-picked hexes. Every colour is generated from the OKLCH seed at pinned L/C and audited with APCA (ink >= 84, secondary >= 52, chromatics >= 57 on face). A colour the engine cannot generate does not ship.

rules.name: The Moderate-Contrast Rule
rules.body: Primary ink targets Lc ~ 85 — above APCA's 75 floor, deliberately below the 90 preferred — because the app is stared at for hours. Raising contrast to fix readability is a bug; fix size or weight instead.

rules.name: The Instrument-Voice Rule
rules.body: Data speaks mono; prose speaks system. Measurements, paths, chords, and status words render in the instrument face — sentences and menus never do.

rules.name: The Closed-Scale Rule
rules.body: No raw font-size literals in view code — every size is a named rung, lint-enforced.

rules.name: The Density-Registers Rule
rules.body: Every surface declares one of three registers — glance, work, supervise — and takes its rhythm from it. A surface may not mix registers.

rules.name: The Fixed-Width Rule
rules.body: Recurring surfaces have one width each, decided by role, not content: popovers 260, toasts 320, form cards 460, settings cards 116, device cards 180.

rules.name: The Depth-By-Light Rule
rules.body: Surfaces separate by luminance rung, never by border-plus-shadow stacks.

rules.name: The One-Altitude Rule
rules.body: All floating cards hover at the same height; only the glass family floats at all.

dos: Do pick a rung from the closed ladders (height, radius, type, spacing) — lint fails raw literals.
Do route every animation through the cubic-bezier tokens (0.12–0.28s); the needle settle is reserved for the connect handshake. No springs.
Do drain, don't hide: anything not live desaturates in place (stalled video with an age caption; done agents' spines dim to 28%).
Do spend identity from the register: spine + wash from the project hue, nothing else recoloured.
Do keep the terminal and chrome one flat field: libghostty's background/foreground/ANSI-16 pin to the same generated hexes.
Do run any new colour through the engine and its APCA audit before it ships.
donts: Don't add at-rest ornament: no grain, no gradients, no glow, no springs, no at-rest motion, no dark-theme shadows.
Don't animate text, ever (marks may pulse; glyph strings may not move).
Don't let identity leak past its budget: no per-row colour plates, no recoloured titles, no identity-tinted icons.
Don't borrow the hazard amber for anything but an agent needing you — other warnings are ink weight, not hue.
Don't give a command outcome a mark; the mark column is the agent's. Outcomes are word colour only.
Don't use .sheet for overlays or vary a floating card's shadow — one glass family, one altitude.
Don't hand-tune a hex or push contrast past the moderate stance (no #FFFFFF text, no #000000 surfaces).
